facts: The conditions during the time of the incident in race 4 were 16-17 knots of wind and small waves.
SUI 2055 and AUT 2013 were sailing upwind 150 m below the finish line, SUI 2055 on starboard, AUT 2013 on port tack on converging courses.
When the distance between the boats was 1,5 m and AUT 2013 was pointing at SUI's bow, AUT 2013 bore away, SUI 2055 held her course.
There was a contact between SUI 2055 port quarter and AUT 2013 bow.
There is a scratch on SUI 2055 quarter.
conclusions: AUT 2013 on port tack failed to keep clear of SUI 2055 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
AUT 2013 did not avoid contact with SUI 2055 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for SUI 2055, the right-of-way boat, to avoid contact with AUT 2013 when it became clear that AUT 2013 was not keeping clear. SUI 2055 did not break RRS 14(a).
